licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets cover the dominant clusters observed: deceptive acts in obtaining or using a license (Fraud & Misrepresentation), poor workmanship and professional incompetence (Negligence & Incompetence), abandonment and failure to complete work per contract terms (Contract Performance Failures), diversion or misapplication of funds and failure to pay (Financial Misconduct), operating without or beyond a license or lending it to others (License Misuse & Unlicensed Activity), violations of building codes, labor, tax, and other statutory requirements (Regulatory & Law Violations), lapsed insurance, bond cancellation, or failure to maintain required financial security (Insurance Bond & Financial Requirements), criminal convictions (Criminal Conviction), and procedural items such as recordkeeping, notification, continuing education, and non-cooperation with investigations (Administrative & Procedural Violations).

profession_specific.voidable_contract_cl.rationale: These seven buckets cleanly separate the distinct clause types found in the data: waivers of statutory/regulatory protections, waivers of judicial remedies (jury trial, claims/defenses), contractor liability releases (hold harmless, repossession), confession-of-judgment and power-of-attorney entries, wage/payment assignments, clauses blocking regulatory complaints, and procedural/formality defects (blank spaces, non-compliance with mandatory elements).
